# Speed Editor auth test vectors: challenge -> response (u64, hex).
# On the wire both are little-endian, bytes 2..10 of feature report 6.
#
# Generated by the orchestrator (with network), not from the Rust port.
# Source: smunaut/blackmagic-misc, commit c0e71caa1b544026ef7f422b48a1b66b0288d91f,
#   file bmd.py (SPDX Apache-2.0, Copyright (C) 2021 Sylvain Munaut),
#   https://github.com/smunaut/blackmagic-misc/blob/c0e71caa1b544026ef7f422b48a1b66b0288d91f/bmd.py
#   bmd.py sha256 963d2d3c278b9df2b5f3f1ac369038a5c062d2db1d8b2a167f7d4ffaec89ddac
# Extraction: only lines 134-177 (rol8, rol8n and bmd_kbd_auth with AUTH_EVEN_TBL,
#   AUTH_ODD_TBL and MASK; no imports), copied into a fresh empty directory as
#   bmd_auth_extract.py (sha256 d94cffa1469a2317a8dc15b861e1b463f9127dd80d3e576c7b25ce31b8375000).
# Commands, with no network (bubblewrap network namespace) and isolated Python:
#   sed -n 134,177p bmd.py > bmd_auth_extract.py
#   bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev --proc /proc --unshare-net --tmpfs /tmp python3 -I gen_vectors.py bmd_auth_extract.py
# where gen_vectors.py imports bmd_auth_extract by path and prints
#   f"0x{c:016x} 0x{bmd_kbd_auth(c):016x}" for each challenge.
# Neither bmd.py nor the extract is committed.
#
# Coverage: challenge & 7 = 0, 7 and 1; both the even and odd table branches.
